suppress.notes: spring-boot-netty is Spring Boot's Netty integration module, not Netty itself; its version (4.0.x) is matched against Netty's CPE. The real Netty jars are scanned on their own.
Spring Boot's Liquibase integration modules are matched against Liquibase's CPE using the Spring Boot version (4.0.x). The Liquibase dependency itself is 5.x.
CVE-2018-1258 only affects Spring Framework 5.0.5 combined with Spring Security; the services run Spring Framework 7.x.
micrometer-registry-prometheus is a metrics client library; it is matched against the Prometheus server's CPE, whose vulnerabilities (e.g. the remote read endpoint) do not apply to it.

langchain-protocol and langchain-ollama are separate packages matched against LangChain's CPE using their own version numbers (0.0.x / 1.1.x). LangChain itself (langchain 1.4.x, langchain-core 1.6.x) is scanned on its own.
The ollama and langchain-ollama Python packages are HTTP clients; the matched CVEs are in the Ollama server, which is not shipped by these services.
CVE-2026-54133 affects jmespath.php and CVE-2022-32511 affects jmespath.rb; the Python package is a separate implementation.
The Python jsonpointer package is matched against the JavaScript json-pointer project's CPE.
